applicationManager.title: Application Manager
applicationManager.description: A serverless web application for registering and managing applicant information.
applicationManager.label: Project
applicationManager.overviewDesc: A serverless web application for registering and managing applicant information. Users can apply to listings after creating an account, with all submissions centrally managed by an admin. Automated email notifications are sent to admins upon new applications.
applicationManager.techDesc: AWS Lambda / API Gateway / DynamoDB / Terraform / Python / JavaScript / Docker / SAM

0.desc: Defined use cases for the application management system and designed operation flows for both users and admins. Structured the overall architecture around a serverless approach.

1.desc: Built user registration and login with session management. Set up a DynamoDB-based data management layer.

2.desc: Implemented user-facing application submission and admin-facing listing/search features. Designed screens and API integration around real business workflows.

3.desc: Implemented admin email notifications on new applications. Designed event-driven processing in a serverless Lambda environment.

4.desc: Managed all AWS resources with Terraform for reproducible infrastructure. Streamlined deployment and operations through automation.

flightInsight.title: Flight Insight
flightInsight.description: A flight analysis dashboard that visualizes price trends by country and month to find the best travel deals.
flightInsight.label: Project
flightInsight.overviewDesc: A travel decision-making tool designed to help you quickly identify the most affordable destinations. By consolidating fragmented price data into a unified dashboard, it allows you to visualize trends by country and month. It eliminates the friction of manual searching, helping users intuitively discover the most economical travel plans through a clean, minimalist UI.
flightInsight.techDesc: React / Vite / Tailwind CSS / Lucide React / TypeScript

0.desc: Addressed the difficulty of comparing prices across multiple countries and months. Defined a minimalist interface focused on comparison, eliminating distractions found in traditional sites.

1.desc: Inspired by Linear and Stripe, I built a UI that prioritizes visual clarity and responsiveness, ensuring that complex travel data is easy to digest.

2.desc: Implemented logic to aggregate and analyze flight price trends. Created a unified view that allows users to make quick, data-driven decisions on their travel budget.

autoLedgerAi.title: Auto Ledger AI
autoLedgerAi.description: A LINE bot that automatically records household expenses from text and receipt photos.
autoLedgerAi.label: Project
autoLedgerAi.overviewDesc: A LINE-based bot for family expense tracking. Just post a message like "500 yen at Seven" or send a receipt image in your LINE group, and AI extracts amount, store, and payer to log it into Google Sheets automatically. No dedicated app installation or manual input is required.
autoLedgerAi.techDesc: TypeScript / Google Apps Script / LINE Messaging API / Groq API / Google Sheets / GitHub Actions

0.desc: Adopted a design centered on LINE group posts for easy family expense sharing. Built the end-to-end data flow from AI text/image parsing to Google Sheets persistence with GAS as the bot runtime.

1.flag: LINE Bot and AI Parser Implementation
1.desc: Implemented extraction of payer, amount, and merchant from natural language messages and receipt images via Groq API triggered by LINE Webhooks. Added retry handling and automatic sender name resolution from LINE user IDs.

2.desc: Built an esbuild pipeline for GAS output and automated deployment via GitHub Actions and clasp. Conducted a security review and fixed risks around credential handling, webhook token validation, and PII exposure in logs.

pashaTen.title: Score Stick Scanner "pasha-ten"
pashaTen.description: Just snap a photo of the mahjong score sticks and AI counts them automatically. No more manual counting mistakes — easily record and share game results with friends and family.
pashaTen.label: Project
pashaTen.overviewDesc: When everyone counts the score sticks by hand after a game, the totals often don't match up. To fix this small but frustrating problem, I built an app that reads the sticks straight from a photo using AI and tallies the score automatically. Friends and family can record and share scores together in a shared group (room), and each person can also see their overall results across every group they've played in.

0.desc: The project started from an everyday frustration: counting score sticks by hand often led to mismatched totals. I set out to build something that could read the score from a simple photo.

1.desc: Using photos I collected myself, I built my own AI model (an ONNX file) that reads the number and value of score sticks from a photo. The model runs right in the user's browser instead of on a server, which keeps running costs down while still returning results instantly.

2.desc: Built a way to organize friends and family into groups, so it's clear who played together in each session.

3.desc: Game results are recorded automatically, and each player can check not just a single session's result but their running total across every game they've taken part in.

4.desc: Reorganized the code by responsibility so it stays easy to read and easy to update going forward.
